ValidationRule.description: A cancelled trip is closed for good: it cannot be reopened and its details, dates, cost and cancellation reason cannot be changed. Plan a new trip instead.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT( ISNEW() ), ISPICKVAL( PRIORVALUE( Status__c ), "Cancelled" ), OR( ISCHANGED( Status__c ), ISCHANGED( Purpose__c ), ISCHANGED( Trip_Type__c ), ISCHANGED( Destination_City__c ), ISCHANGED( Start_Date__c ), ISCHANGED( End_Date__c ), ISCHANGED( Estimated_Cost__c ), ISCHANGED( Cancellation_Reason__c ), ISCHANGED( Cancelled_On__c ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: This trip is cancelled and can no longer be changed. Create a new trip instead.
